changes.comment: sdk-backend-tiger, sdk-ui-dashboard: A dashboard filter is now restricted also when its parent filter is restricted, or when a "Filter values by" item (a metric, a fact or a "Count of" attribute) is one the user cannot access. It is hidden, counted among the restricted filters and applied nowhere: not in widgets, exports, automations, key driver analysis, drills to dashboards or custom URL drills. Before, the filter stayed applied and only lost the restricted parent or limit.
